text: Founded in 2000, the International Preparatory Education Program of Peking University (PKU) provides one to two years of training for international students who have graduated from high school and have excellent academic records and are interested in pursuing a bachelor's degree at PKU. Peking University Preparatory School is committed to creating a new pattern of all-round scientific education, and strives to provide professional language training, international cultural exchange, first-class undergraduate integration and other platforms for international students to study in Peking University. After the preparatory study, international students who pass the assessment and meet the standards can be admitted to Peking University for undergraduate studies.
